abilities.description: Every few spells, Malzahar summons an uncontrollable Voidling to engage his enemies. Voidlings grow over time, gaining armor, damage, and attack speed.
Malzahar opens up two portals to the Void. After a short delay, they fire projectiles that deal Magic Damage and silence enemy champions.

abilities.description: Malzahar creates a zone of negative energy that damages nearby enemies each second.
Malzahar infects his target's mind, dealing damage over time. If the target dies during this time, the visions pass to a nearby enemy and Malzahar gains mana.
Malzahar channels the essence of the Void to suppress target champion while dealing magic damage over time.
